tldr: Mercury through the 5th house brings focus to creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy.
body: Mercury transiting the 5th house activates creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy. For a few weeks, thought, conversation, planning, and messages move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a thinking transit: it favors planning, conversations, edits, decisions, and information-gathering around the house topic.
business: Mercury supports creative output and playful risk: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Overthinking, mixed messages, or performing for validation.
advice: Name the details in the 5th house deliberately. Work with creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
